PROFILE 
Senior Data Expert with 8+ years of experience in Data Analysis, Data Modeling, and

Strong expertise in Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Modeling, SQL-based

stakeholders and IT, and ensuring clarity, traceability, and alignment across the SDLC. 
Hands-on experience with GCP BigQuery, cloud data platforms, and modern data 
governance practices.
